challenge.method: Trace the no-initializer evaluation and distinguish time before evaluation, evaluation itself and per-iteration binding initialization. Check the different observable outcomes in a local runtime.
challenge.results: The claim applies when this production executes. The pre-declaration read and the loop binding use different rules and do not establish a contradiction. The local Node.js v24.4.1 diagnostic agreed. Undefined after declaration; referenceerror before it; for-of supplied 3.
